title: The whistle, over the town
logline: The last mill whistle, 1994, drawn as sound over the whole town: a jagged shape from the stack laid across every roof, the school, the Lanes, the bay. Era I's spotting.

panels.composition: The town from the bluff in 1994 — the mill's stack, the school, the Lanes all lit, the bay — and from the stack a great jagged sound-shape spreading across every roof to the page's edges. Heavy black spotting. The whistle as weather.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no borders, heavy black ink spotting in a 1990s zine style over a muted ochre wash, a small coastal town from a bluff with a mill smokestack and a jagged sound shape spreading from it across every rooftop to the page edges, no words
image.notes: Era I's spotting for the mill sequence. The Lanes fully lit: 1994.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The whistle as weather. The Lanes all lit.
